name: roxy-client
_comment: This root is NOT an npm workspaces root — there is deliberately no `workspaces` field, and apps/mobile and apps/studio each carry their own package-lock.json. So anything listed here is installed into the root node_modules and is reachable from BOTH apps by Node's parent-directory fallback, without appearing in either app's lockfile. It held expo ^55.0.24, react-dom 19.2.0 and @types/react ~19.2.10 against an app pinned to expo 51.0.39 / React 18.2.0 — four majors adrift. Nothing at root imported them (the scripts here are Supabase-only) and apps/mobile carries its own copies, so nothing resolved to them; but `npx expo` run from the repo root picked Expo 55, and the day apps/mobile lost a package it would have silently fallen back to a React 19 type tree. Keep this list to what the root scripts actually import.
